subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app onboards an already configured connected Gateway

question: Should steipete keep this protected issue as a maintainer-owned macOS launch-routing fix, or clear the protected label so a narrow automated repair can be queued later?
rationale: The bug boundary is clear, but the protected `maintainer` label and live assignment are explicit workflow signals that cleanup automation should not bypass.

options.title: Keep maintainer-owned
options.body: Leave the protected label and assignment in place while the macOS owner lands the launch-routing fix with real app proof.

options.title: Delegate narrow repair
options.body: A maintainer can remove the protected label or explicitly request automation, then queue a focused fix for the macOS launch/onboarding scheduler.

recommendation.title: Keep maintainer-owned
recommendation.body: Leave the protected label and assignment in place while the macOS owner lands the launch-routing fix with real app proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and authored the recent macOS local Gateway onboarding work most directly connected to this regression.
